cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
cards.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my ear to the wall like you. It wants quiet. Stop resetting the light; ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm listening for buzzing wires. I need light to work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wiring heard, yes. Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel that. Ask the house about overtime; we need its agreement before booking your evening shifts.

reason: Copied electrical listening becomes hearing house wishes; B responsive desk light drives request to surrender ordinary repair entirely.
